SUMMARY.md: Crowd-sourced acoustic analysis of music recordings, keyed by MusicBrainz Recording ID (MBID). Low-level data holds acoustic descriptors (loudness, dynamics, spectral shape, rhythm, tonal information); high-level data holds semantically meaningful features. Bulk endpoints accept at most 25 recordings per request. Rate limited to roughly 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP, reported via X-RateLimit-* response headers.
